ItemID: NA; Title: Deftones; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Atmospheric heaviness sounds appealing after spending time with Tool and In Flames.

ItemID: NA; Title: Risk; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its more restrained rock direction is less appealing than the heavier sound I am seeking.
